summary_markdown:
# Beta Status: Balcony App 3.0

- 41 testers as of this morning, 2 new over the weekend
- Two crash reports, both on Android 11, both triggered by opening camera during inspection
  - 6 total Android 11 testers; other 4 haven’t hit it yet
  - Likely in the photo layer; someone is picking it up to investigate
- Offline sync bug: editing the same inspection on two devices while offline causes one edit to silently drop on reconnect
  - Clean repro steps in hand
  - Suspected root cause: merge logic when both versions come back online
  - High priority: offline is the core value prop of this release

# Release Checklist and Go/No-Go

- Release checklist owned and being tracked
- Go/no-go call proposed for Friday 13th November at 09:30
  - Both parties confirmed availability
  - Invite to be sent after standup

# Schema Bridge Kickoff Concerns

- Kickoff today at 15:00 with Romeo
- Key risk: if Schema Bridge depends on Montague’s mesh routing, Balcony inherits their uptime as a dependency
  - If Montague’s service goes down, Balcony could stop working entirely
  - This would be a new single point of failure outside the team’s control
- Two asks before anything reaches customers:
  - Clarify whether the dependency is hard or soft
  - Get the answer written down formally

# Next Steps

- **Raise mesh routing dependency risk with Romeo at the 15:00 kickoff**

  Add it to the agenda right after scope; report back to the team on what he says.
- **Send go/no-go calendar invite for Friday 13th November at 09:30**

  Both attendees confirmed availability.
- **Investigate Android 11 camera crash**

  Two crash reports on the same device type; suspected issue in the photo layer.
